ValidationRule.description: When the Switcher Document status has been updated from Attached to Invalid, the fields Invalid Switcher Reason is blank
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( SC_Record_Type_Formula__c="Sales Support", ISCHANGED(SC_SwitcherDocumentStatus__c), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(SC_SwitcherDocumentStatus__c), "Attached"), ISPICKVAL(SC_SwitcherDocumentStatus__c, "Invalid"), ISPICKVAL(SC_InvalidSwitcherReason__c, "") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select an Invalid Switcher Reason before saving.
